profile.headline: Software Engineering Leader | Engineering Management | Medical Devices & SaMD | FDA 510(k) | Cloud Architecture | AI & Digital Health
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineering Leader with 10+ years of experience in software development, architecture, and engineering leadership, specializing in medical devices, Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), and cloud-based platforms.

Throughout my career, I've worked at the intersection of engineering, product development, and regulated healthcare technology, helping bring complex software products from concept to market.

Currently, I lead software engineering initiatives at LinkBio. My responsibilities span engineering strategy, software architecture, team leadership, technical execution, and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Quality, Regulatory, and executive leadership.

My experience includes contributing to successful FDA 510(k) clearance, supporting regulatory submissions, and building scalable software solutions in highly regulated environments.

Beyond technical execution, I'm passionate about developing high-performing engineering teams, mentoring technical leaders, improving engineering processes, and aligning technology decisions with business objectives.

I'm particularly interested in the intersection of engineering leadership, artificial intelligence, cloud technologies, and digital health.

Areas of Expertise:
- Software Engineering Leadership & Management
- Medical Devices & Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)
- FDA-Regulated Software Development & 510(k)
- Software Architecture & Cloud Platforms
- Engineering Strategy & Technical Roadmaps
- Cross-Functional Leadership & Product Delivery
- AI-Enabled Software Development
- Team Development & Technical Mentorship

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering Leadership | Medical Devices | SaMD | Cloud Architecture

- Lead software engineering initiatives, overseeing technical strategy, architecture, development, and delivery.
- Provide technical leadership and engineering management across multidisciplinary teams, coordinating backend, frontend, testing, and product engineering activities.
- Contributed to the successful FDA 510(k) clearance of an intraoperative medical device software platform and subsequent regulatory submission activities.
- Drive architectural decisions for cloud healthcare platforms, focusing on scalability, security, reliability, and regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate with executive leadership, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners to align engineering execution with business and product objectives.
- Mentor engineering leads and developers, establish technical priorities, and improve software development processes across multiple products.
